name: sure
description: Sure — a fast, local financial tracker (Rust + Axum + SQLite backend, Svelte SPA frontend).
//packageManager: pnpm 12 writes pnpm-lock.yaml as two YAML documents (a `packageManagerDependencies` document, then the dependency graph). Until dependabot/dependabot-core#15904, GitHub's dependency graph read only the first and saw zero dependencies, which held this on 11.x. #15904 was closed as completed on 2026-11-03; the move to 12.18.0 on 2026-11-14 is checked by the dependency graph on main still listing the npm packages (486 on 11.x), via `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependency-graph/sbom`. If that count drops to zero, go back to 11.x.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm dev:api" "node scripts/wait-for-backend.mjs && pnpm dev:web"
scripts.build: pnpm gen:client && cargo build --release && pnpm --filter @sure/web build
scripts.test: pnpm test:rust && pnpm test:api && pnpm test:web
